title: ADR-0004: Audit trail actor comes from the authenticated identity
summary: The actor in referral_events is now set from the authenticated user's email instead of a client-supplied field, so status-change audit records can't be spoofed.
notes: Output filename omits the SHA-256 path-hash suffix: this agent has no shell/hash tool, so it follows the convention of sibling file 0001-one-shot-migration-before-api.json. The filename is unique within docs/adr/.
